notes.title: Last Hope V1.1
notes.notes:
Last Hope V1.1 Changes

Changelog Video:
[previewyoutube=fugRmHBeSNw;full][/previewyoutube]


- -- ---  NEW ADDITIONS  --- -- -

[ADDED] - Goals
                   - A Large Goal To Beat the Game
                   - Smaller Goals to show how to progress through the game.
[ADDED] - 1 Second Invisibility on Respawn
[ADDED] - 3 More Hotbar Slots
                   - Slot 6 added for the Light Staff
                   - Slot 7 added for the Machete
                   - Slot 8 added for the Boat Blueprint
[ADDED] - Controls Button in the Pause Menu
                   - Control Menu shows what controls are in the game
[ADDED] - Exit Button in the Pause Menu
[ADDED] - Some More Rocks and Bushes

- -- ---  FIXES  --- -- -

[FIXED] - Hammer from not showing up until Player has Died once
[FIXED] - Some of the Gate Sprites
[FIXED] - Win Screen Exit Button
[FIXED] - Sound Effects Now Play From the Start
[FIXED] - Made Ghost Opacity Higher When Not Spotted
[FIXED] - Made the Game Beatable Again

- -- ---  CHANGES  --- -- -

[CHANGE] - Lowered Enemy damages
[CHANGE] - Added a Timer to the Boat Builder
                     - ( instead of having to wait a day to make progress on the Boat )
